actual_scope: Four separate successful V916 cold boots reach original naval combat via two declared coordinate-only approaches and two/three room/occupant bytes. Original Chapel18 prayer1648,real captain1 prayer1654,Emilio Planning19 three-row snack1663 and real captain1 Marine Barracks request1666 each have two complete active-widget bitmap/RGB holds and normal returns. The captain Chapel assignment occurs only after original combat0/1 is observed and asserted by its three-byte helper;travel assignments remain original until then. An extra early-assignment CaptainChapel run is preserved as pre-combat zero-sailor-warning research with no battle-display credit and no established causal diagnosis. No savestate,actor/captain replacement,battle-mode,outcome,health,money or text injection. The other20 records,including Rafaels named Claudio prayer1653 and Lils three-row1667 reflection,have full native-font/source proof,not individual actual visits. No earned recruitment,refit,travel,complete route or hardware claim.
